metric_notes.operating_cash: Net cash provided by operating activities
metric_notes.capex: Reported capital expenditures shown as an outflow
metric_notes.cash_after_capex: Operating cash flow less reported capital expenditures
metric_notes.depreciation: Includes depletion reported in the cash flow statement
metric_notes.ebitda: Operating earnings + depreciation, depletion and amortization
metric_notes.short_debt: Short-term debt + current maturities − current finance leases
metric_notes.long_debt: Long-term debt less current maturities and non-current finance leases
metric_notes.long_liabilities: Sum of non-current debt, deferred tax and other non-current liabilities

notes.heading: Verified baseline
notes.text: The verified baseline uses the FY2025 Form 10-K for three years of earnings and cash flow. Its FY2023 balance sheet and lease figures come from the FY2024 filing’s comparative columns.

notes.heading: Debt and leases
notes.text: The borrowing rows exclude finance lease liabilities already included in reported debt. The lease rows include both finance and operating leases, so net debt counts each lease liability once. Structured accounts payable remains in current liabilities. Mosaic’s operating lease cost remains in operating earnings used for EBITDA.
